title: Synthesis, Crystal Structure and Properties of a New One‐Dimensional 3d‐4f Compound
abstract: AbstractA new heterometallic complex K2[{Eu(H2O)4}2{Fe11(bipy)(CN)4}4] 9H2O CH3OH [bipy=2,2′‐bipyridine] was synthesized. The compound has been characterized by X‐ray structure analysis, elemental analyses, IR spectrum, TGA thermogram and magnetic susceptibility. The complex consists of novel one‐dimensional ladder structure. The crystal belongs to monoclinic system with a space group P21/c. a =1.3946(4) nm, b=2.0450(6) nm. c=2.9722(8) nm. β= 99.W(5), V=8.372(4) nm3, Z=4. Dc= 1.562 g cm−3.
